summary: Pakistani organizations should prioritize patching critical vulnerabilities, particularly CVE-2026-8037 and CVE-2026-63077, which are being actively exploited and have been added to the CISA KEV catalog, affecting multiple vendors including Microsoft and Adobe. The presence of 75 zero-day exploits, including CVE-2026-18556 and CVE-2026-34486, poses a significant threat to local networks, and immediate attention is required to mitigate these risks. Pakistani CERT alerts, such as PKCERT-917CDA37 and PKCERT-78CA5DA2, also highlight the need for organizations to review their security posture and implement measures to protect against targeted attacks, especially those leveraging vulnerabilities in widely used software like Adobe Acrobat and Microsoft Office.

Check Point SmartConsole contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an application login token and use it to authenticate with full administrative privileges.

WordPress Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability when a plugin or theme passes untrusted input to the parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-63030 to allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain remote code execution on default WordPress installations.
